name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.

Rover, Tungsten, and Blowtorch belong to different engineers.
Otis, Bridge, and $37k belong to different engineers.
The engineer on the Bridge's budget is immediately below the engineer with the Oscilloscope.
The engineer using Steel's budget is lower than both Diesel and the engineer with the Caliper.
